reason: I already bring my stock through the Erbil company and it mostly works, so I don't need a new middleman. For resale, 21,000 IQD in fees on a 30,000 item eats my margin, and I bet my current agent is cheaper per kilo.
objection: Your fees are almost as much as the item itself, and after the first order I have to pay up front to a new service I don't know yet, when the one I use already delivers fine.
would_change_my_mind: A lower per-kilo rate than my current agent for bulk orders, or my current service letting me down on a shipment.
